name: Defilement
overview: Scripture presents defilement primarily in terms of ceremonial uncleanness, emphasizing the importance of separation from unclean things to maintain holiness before God. The sample verses from Leviticus highlight that touching unclean carcasses or eating sacrifices contaminated by uncleanness results in being cut off from the people, underscoring the severity of defilement and its consequences. This teaching reflects God's demand for purity among His people, distinguishing them from other nations, as seen also in the separation practiced by the Egyptians in Genesis. Ultimately, these laws point to the seriousness of defilement and its impact on fellowship with God and the community.
